knowledgeAnswers.rationale: A fire-rated closer is part of the fire safety system and is referred, and quoted separately.
A stripped hole is fixed with a longer screw or a packed hole. Tightening harder can strip the hole further.

The Queensland matrix records that removing and reinstalling household locks needs a licence unless the building is under construction, repair or renovation (Queensland Government page, last updated 21 October 2026).

practicalCriteria: Given a sticking door, the worker identifies the cause, makes a minor fix within scope, and records a before and after condition.
The worker identifies a fire-rated door in the simulated site and refers it without adjustment.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Door condition record, before and after
Quote with included, optional and referred tasks
stopWorkCriteria: A fire-rated door or its closer is involved
A security lock or access hardware is to be altered and the licence position cannot be checked
